summary:
Added the weekly/manual exact-image Trivy workflow, offline render helper, Renovate discovery coverage, and canonical documentation. The workflow resolves platform-specific digests, scans ARM64 production/controller images and AMD64 local images, retains seven-day reports, fails unexpected incomplete scans, and keeps findings non-gating.

Validation passed: Node 24/npm prerequisite; Renovate strict validation and extraction (104 occurrences across 35 files); actionlint; bash syntax and ShellCheck; offline rendering of 32 targets; representative Redis, Temurin, External Secrets, Kyverno, and Prometheus scans; database/scan error-retention tests; OCI lockstep checks; static security guardrails and self-tests; diff checks.

Kyverno GHSA-79gf-7frw-68m9 and Prometheus GHSA-vffh-x6r8-xx99 were reproduced through their CVE aliases. Redis application metadata, Temurin JDK metadata, both External Secrets advisories, and Prometheus GHSA-8rm2-7qqf-34qm remain missing. Istio gateway `image: auto` is explicitly reported as unscannable without a live injector. No dependency images or versions were upgraded.

Handoff references: docs/dependency-automation.md, docs/research/dependency-automation-coverage.md, scripts/security/render-image-scan-inputs.sh, and .github/workflows/exact-image-security-evidence.yml.
